scope: Proof Step7 identification of the selected marked resolution, propagated to Steps6 and8
old_claim: The (b,x), generically (z,x), resolution along the main diagonal is the selected marked cusp used for X(u).
exact_comparison: (X,Y,Z,V,u)=(z,rw,x,y,r^2) to the A1.2 node. The selected A1.2 edge is [e1,e2], requiring (z,y), hence (b,y), with valuation alpha+beta-gamma.
correction: Use b=yk,x=kw and y=bj,w=jx; j=k^-1,(b,x)=k(y,w). The two maps to A1.2 have parameters (y,w/r,rk) and (rb,x,j/r). The involution lifts as written in the guard.
comparison_between_old_and_new_resolutio: Both map properly to bw=xy and are isomorphisms off its node. The common blowup has exceptional quadric [b:x:y:w] with bw=xy, parametrized by [u0v0:u0v1:u1v0:u1v1]; its two projections to the row/column projective factors give the two small resolutions and contract opposite rulings. No nonisomorphism assertion about the compact threefolds is made.
literature_scope: Engel Proposition2.8 permits any periodic unimodular triangular tiling. The required chosen edge is Paper I’s marked A1.2 choice, not a purported uniquely prescribed Engel anti-diagonal.
credit: Exposed correction and exact computation; no before-proof targeted check credit.
